name: towards5GS Helm Charts
what_it_is: Helm chart repository by Orange that enables one-click deployment of a complete 5G standalone system (Free5GC core + UERANSIM RAN simulator) on Kubernetes. Bundles all 5G network functions as reusable Helm charts for cloud-native 5G research and testing.
components: Free5GC core network functions (NRF, AUSF, UDM, UDR, PCF, NSSF)
protocols: GTP-U (GPRS Tunneling Protocol User Plane — UPF data path)
NGAP (NG Application Protocol — gNB to AMF)
PFCP (Packet Forwarding Control Protocol — SMF to UPF)
SBI (Service-Based Interface over HTTP/2 — between core NFs)
measurement: No built-in metrics or monitoring stack included
CI/CD Helm chart linting via GitHub Actions (chart validation only)
configuration: Per-chart values.yaml files for each NF
Multus CNI network attachment definitions for secondary interfaces
gtp5g kernel module configuration for GTP tunnel handling
UE IMSI, key, and slice configuration in UERANSIM values
SMF UPF association and PDU session parameters
AMF PLMN, TAC, and slice (S-NSSAI) settings
modes: Standalone 5G (SA) mode only — no NSA (Non-Standalone) support
Simulated RAN mode via UERANSIM (no physical radio hardware)
constraints: Requires Multus CNI plugin installed on the Kubernetes cluster for multiple network interfaces
Requires gtp5g kernel module loaded on worker nodes for GTP-U tunnel support
Targets Kubernetes only — no docker-compose or bare-metal deployment path provided
UERANSIM simulates UE/gNB; no real UE or radio hardware integration
notable_absences: No built-in observability stack (no Prometheus, Grafana, or Jaeger)
No fault injection or chaos engineering tooling
No performance benchmarking or traffic generation beyond UERANSIM
No NSA (Non-Standalone / LTE anchor) mode support
Specific CPU/memory resource requirements not documented in README
